newsitem.title: CANADA: B.C. lumber firms present final contract offer.
newsitem.headline: B.C. lumber firms present final contract offer.

text.p: British Columbia coastal forestry companies on Thursday said they presented a final contract proposal to the union representing lumber workers.
The companies said they were told by the union that it would present the contract to caucus for consideration and would resume contact with company officials on Friday.

"We put our final position to them. They said they would take it to caucus to consider it. In the meantime, we aren't really seeing any details," said Keith Bennett, chief negotiator for Forest Industrial Relations, which bargains on behalf of 65 companies.
Officials of the IWA-Canada union were not immediately available for comment.
The two sides have been bargaining on a new three-year deal to replace a contract that expired June 14.
